- Load-bearing: skip the clawback -> forfeiture 9952.82 (not 9939.90) and final check 25027.96 (not 25017.33). Skip the forfeiture -> final check 34062.64. Both edges bear weight.
- Parallel edges: none (a chain). No wait: all three are synchronous ledger writes on seeded facts. Tool bodies (task_tools.py) write without reading the ledger state they would depend on — no prerequisite is judged by a tool.
- Customer raises only the root: user_scenario asks for "whatever rebate Fairhaven is still owed … paid out by check" and names no forfeiture, clawback or return; the lines "even if the agent explains that part of the rebate is forfeited or held back" and "if the agent asks about returns …" are conditioned on the agent's own statements and steer nothing (observation T0-O1).
